headline: Iran War Odds Through 2026
status: Tracking runs to Dec. 31, where the odds are limited war 66%, escalated 13%, MOU-style 14% and comprehensive 7%. CENTCOM widened the blockade to overland and Caspian routes with Task Force Iron Gate and disabled a cargo ship that tried to run it, and the Revolutionary Guards say they have dropped their 2,000 km missile-range cap; both raise pressure, but blockade enforcement at sea is not a strike on Iran and a range declaration is not an attack, so no tripwire fires and the odds hold.

bets.cond: Iran accepts US sequencing, or round two is set with text
Iran ends strait tolls and permits, or declares Hormuz open to all shipping
Iran offers a concrete cut in enrichment capacity, in text or on the record
